records.name: Beverage list reorder
records.description: Happy path: A mobile user opens the Beverages screen, scans filters (category chips) and the list of drink items (each with icon, name, meta, percentage and an inclusion toggle). They reorder items by pressing the drag affordance and dragging a card to a new position. The app shows the dragged card as an elevated floating item and a placeholder where it will land. On release the item snaps into the new order. Entry: user is on the Beverages section of the app (mobile). Exit: the beverage list is updated with the new order and toggles remain as set. Assumes a logged-in user on a touch device with drag-and-drop enabled.
records.problem: User task: Reorder and manage which beverages count toward hydration/tracking. From the user's perspective they want to change the order of drinks (for priority or personal preference) and quickly enable/disable individual drinks via toggles, expecting immediate visual feedback and persistence of order. From the interface perspective the screen provides: category filter chips at the top, a vertical list of beverage cards each containing an icon, title, optional subtext (e.g. caffeine), a percentage value, and a right-side drag handle and inclusion toggle. The UI supports touch/long-press to pick up a card, shows the card as a floating elevated element, displays a drop placeholder in the list, and on drop re-renders the list in the new order. Result: User-perceived outcome — the chosen beverage appears in its new position and toggles remain unchanged; System-level outcome — the app updates and persists the beverage order (and maintains each item's enabled/disabled state), and the visual list reflects the new order immediately.

steps.name: View Beverages list
steps.goal: See all available beverages, their hydration contribution and enable/disable status
steps.action: Scan category chips and scroll the vertical list of beverage cards. Optionally tap toggles to include/exclude drinks.
steps.system_response: Screen displays category filter chips (All, Tea, Coffee, etc.), a 'Add' button, and beverage cards showing icon, name, meta (e.g. caffeine), percentage and an enabled toggle. List is scrollable and shows a drag affordance on the right of each card.

content.description:
High-level overview
- This is a vertical, single-column mobile screen titled "Beverages" used to browse and manage a list of drink types. The screen has a top navigation row (back button at left, title centered, a rounded "+Add" floating button at top-right). Directly under the title is a group of pill-shaped category filters (chips) arranged in wrapping rows. Below the chips is a small uppercase section label "HYDRATION" followed by a vertically stacked list of rounded rectangular cards—one card per beverage.

Background and layout
- Overall background: very light off-white (near #FFFFFF with subtle warm tint). Use a faint page-level background color for the content area: #F6F7F8 (very pale gray) to separate cards from background.
- Safe area top: mimic iPhone notch spacing; header sits below status bar with generous top padding (approx 28–36px from top edge depending on device).
- Main column: single column, centered content with side padding ~20–24px. Content width ~ (screen width - 48px) to keep substantial horizontal side padding.

Header / Navigation
- Left: circular back button (44x44px) — white circular background with soft drop shadow; inner chevron icon in dark navy (#393535). Circle uses subtle elevation (shadow: rgba(57,53,53,0.06) 0px 6px 12px).
- Title: "Beverages" centered horizontally, font-weight bold, large size ~30px (or 28px on smaller scale), color #393535 (very dark desaturated navy). Line-height ~36px, centered alignment.
- Right: floating primary action button "+Add" (oval/pill, approx 84x40px). Background turquoise #0ABCD3, white text + small cup icon. Button has subtle shadow and a slight glow/elevation.

Category chips (filter row)
- Chips are pill-shaped buttons with large corner radius (height ~40px, radius ~20px). They wrap into multiple rows and have consistent horizontal spacing ~12–14px and vertical spacing ~10px.
- Inactive chips: very light fill (#F3F4F5) with medium gray text (#ABACA8). Active chip: dark rounded pill filled with #393535 and white text. Font size ~14–16px, weight 600 for active label, 500 for inactive.

Section label
- Small uppercase label "HYDRATION" positioned above the list. Font size ~12px, weight 700, letter spacing +1px, color #ABACA8, centered horizontally.

List of beverage cards
- Cards: full-width rounded rectangles with a soft off-white background (#FFFFFF or #FBFCFC) and very subtle inner shadow or elevation to lift from page. Card height ~68–80px (depends on subtitle presence). Corner radius ~18–22px. Vertical spacing between cards ~14–18px.
- Left area: small colorful drink icon (vector illustration) sized ~36x36–44x44px aligned with card left padding ~18px. Icons use bright saturated colors (examples in this screen: blue for Water, green for Green Tea, brown for Coffee, orange for Juice, pink for Smoothie, gray for Milk, red for Soda). Icons are flat illustrations, no heavy stroke.
- Main text: beverage name in dark navy #393535, font-size ~16–18px, weight 700. If present, a secondary subtitle sits below the name (e.g., "25mg caffeine") in small, muted gray #ABACA8, font-size ~12–13px, weight 500.
- Right area: a percent label (e.g., "100%", "90%") in medium gray #ABACA8, font-size ~16px, aligned center-right inside the card with right padding ~96px (to leave space for toggle). To the far-right (near card edge) there is a toggle switch control.
- Toggle switches: custom iOS-style pill toggles ~52x32px. Active fill color: turquoise #0ABCD3; knob color: white. Inactive thumb state shows white fill and turquoise outline (but most shown are active). Toggle has subtle shadow and uses rounded radius equal to half height.
- Reorder / handle icons: a small vertical chevron/up-down or grip handle is visible at extreme right of each card (tiny glyph), used for drag/reorder. Color muted gray #ABACA8.

Typography
- Header / Title: Bold sans-serif (Semantic equivalent: SF Pro Display / Inter / Poppins / Montserrat). Size ~28–32px, weight 700.
- Card title: same family, weight 700, size 16–18px.
- Subtitle: weight 500, size 12–13px, color #ABACA8.
- Chip labels: weight 600 (active), 500 (inactive), size 14–16px.

Colors (use given palette plus supporting neutrals)
- Primary dark navy / title text: #393535
- Accent yellow (sparingly used / brand): #DCBC05 (not visible heavily in this screen but in provided palette)
- Primary action / toggles / accent bright teal: #0ABCD3
- Muted gray (subtitle, percent, chips inactive): #ABACA8
- Secondary purple accent in palette: #A46BCD (not used strongly on the shown screen, reserved for illustrations)
- Card backgrounds / very light: #FFFFFF / #F6F7F8

Spacing & measurements (based on 375pt width mobile artboard)
- Side padding: 20–24px
- Title top margin: 14–22px below status bar
- Chips row top margin from title: 16–22px
- Chip height: 40px; horizontal padding inside chip: 18–20px
- Card horizontal padding: 16–20px; card height 72–80px; icon left margin 14–18px
- Toggle size: 52x32px; toggle right margin ~16px
- Card corner radius: 18–22px

States & interactions / microcopy
- Chip states: active (filled dark with white text), inactive (light fill, gray text), pressed state: darker gray background and subtle scale down.
- Toggle states: on (thumb right, fill #0ABCD3), off (thumb left, neutral fill), with smooth 180–220ms ease-out transition.
- Card tap: reveals detail or editing screen; long-press reveals drag handles for reorder; drag handle area indicates reorder affordance.
- +Add: primary action to create a new beverage entry or add to tracked list.

Animations
- Toggle animation: 180ms, ease-out, thumb translates horizontally with slight scale/opacity micro-shadow.
- Chip select/deselect: 160–200ms fade + color transition; small scale for active feedback.
- Card press: subtle 100–120ms scale down (0.98) and shadow increase.

Accessibility
- High contrast text for titles (#393535 on light background). Tap targets: chips and toggles >= 44x44pt.

Visual style summary
- Clean, soft, rounded aesthetic with a focus on pill/chip shapes and rounded cards. Bright flat illustrations for quick identification of drinks. Calm neutral text colors with a strong turquoise accent for interactive controls and a deep navy for headings.
content.layout:
Overall layout
- Single-column vertical layout with header/navigation at the top, followed by chip-based filter controls, a small section label, and a vertically stacked list of cards.

Regions and grouping
1) Top navigation bar (one horizontal group)
   - Left: circular back button (icon inside circle)
   - Center: main title "Beverages"
   - Right: floating primary action "+Add" (pill-shaped button)

2) Filter chip area (one wrapping group)
   - Pill chips arranged over roughly 2–3 rows depending on screen width. The chips wrap horizontally and are grouped in a contiguous area under the title with equal horizontal and vertical spacing.
   - Example arrangement: row1 [All 116] [Tea] [Coffee] [Milk] ; row2 [Sugar] [Fruit] [Active] [Mocktail] ; row3 [Alcohol] [Other]

3) Section label (single centered row)
   - Small uppercase label "HYDRATION" providing context before the list.

4) List region (single column grid)
   - A single-column list (one item per row) of rounded cards. Count of rows is dynamic; in this screenshot there are multiple visible rows (Water, Green Tea, Coffee, Juice, Smoothie, Milk, Soda). Each card contains three main columns inside: icon/left content, central text block (title/subtitle), right controls area (percent + toggle + drag handle)

Card internal layout (columns per card)
   - Column 1 (left, fixed width): drink icon (~40px) with margin to left edge.
   - Column 2 (middle, flexible): Title and optional subtitle stacked vertically, left-aligned.
   - Column 3 (right, fixed width): percent label (centered vertically) and toggle control to the far right; a micro drag-handle sits at the extreme right outside toggle.

Grid specifics
- Columns: effectively 1 main column for the entire screen. Inside each card, use a 3-column internal grid (left icon, middle text, right controls). The internal columns can be implemented with flex layout: icon fixed width, text flex-grow, controls fixed width.
- Rows: list rows are uniform height and visually separated with consistent vertical gutters.

Keywords to describe layout: single-column, centered header, pill-filters, stacked cards, left-icon card, right-toggle control, wrap chips, touch targets, drag handles, light elevation
content.functions:
Actions (atomic / on this screen)
- Tap back chevron to return to the previous screen.
- Tap "+Add" button to create or add a new beverage entry (opens a modal or form).
- Tap a category chip (e.g., All, Tea, Coffee, Milk) to filter the beverage list; active chip highlights in dark fill and updates the visible list.
- Tap a card to open the beverage detail or edit view (likely includes nutrition, serving size, caffeine content).
- Tap the toggle on a card to enable or disable tracking for that beverage; toggles visually switch between on/off states and persist.
- Tap the reorder/grip icon to drag and reorder the list (long press + drag) — visual handles indicate draggable items.
- Read the hydration percent to understand contribution or relative hydration score for each beverage.

Medium-level tasks / flows
- Filter and refine the list: selecting different chips to narrow down drinks by type (Sugar, Fruit, Alcohol, etc.). The UI shows immediate filtered results and updates the counts (e.g., "All 116").
- Configure tracked beverages: add, enable/disable toggles, or reorder priority of tracked drinks. Toggling updates whether the drink counts toward hydration/metrics.
- Inspect beverage details: tapping a beverage takes user to a detailed view where they can read added metadata (e.g., "25mg caffeine").

High-level goal / purpose
- The primary purpose is to let users browse, filter, and manage a catalog of beverages relevant to hydration and intake tracking. The screen facilitates quick scanning (icons + names), filtering by category, turning tracking on/off with toggles, and adding new items. The design aims to make configuring which beverages the user will track easy and visual, supporting the broader product goal of tracking hydration and beverage consumption efficiently.

steps.name: Pick up item to move
steps.goal: Change position of a beverage in the list
steps.action: Long-press or use the drag handle on the target card (Milk) to pick it up and drag vertically.
steps.system_response: The selected card becomes an elevated floating overlay (visually separated with a shadow/white card), other list items shift to reveal a placeholder. The floating card follows the touch, indicating drag-and-drop is active.

content.description:
High-level summary
A clean, modern mobile listing screen for beverage items used to track hydration/caffeine impact. The layout is single-column, vertically scrollable with a centered page title, a row-wrapped set of category filter chips beneath it, then a subtle section label (“HYDRATION”) and a list of rounded card rows. Each row shows a colourful small beverage icon on the left, a two-line label area (name + optional subtext such as caffeine), a numeric percentage value aligned near the center/right, and a rounded toggle switch on the right. A drag-handle / reorder affordance is present as a faint two-arrow icon to the far right of each row. One row (Milk) appears elevated/in-drag as an overlapping card with stronger shadow to indicate movement.
Overall visual style
- Soft, friendly, slightly rounded aesthetic with generous white space and roomy touch targets. Visual language leans iOS-native (SF-like type, circular back control, pill-shaped buttons). Use of subtle elevation (soft shadows) to separate cards from a very light background.
- Feel: friendly, modern, approachable; emphasis on clarity and quick scanning.
Color palette (approximate hex values based on screenshot)
- Background (overall): #FBFBFB (very pale warm white)
- Card background / primary surface: #FFFFFF (pure white)
- Primary text (headings, item labels): #3A3638 (very dark slate)
- Secondary text (captions, sublabels): #AAACA7 (muted gray)
- Accent / primary action (toggles, add button): #0ABDD7 (cyan / aqua)
- Highlight / accent yellow (provided palette, used sparingly for icons or badges): #DDBE06
- Inactive chip background: #F3F4F5 (pale gray)
- Selected chip background: #3A3638 (dark) with white text
- Card shadow (light): rgba(58,54,56,0.06)
- Thin separators / icon chevrons: #E9EAEB or rgba(170,172,167,0.15)
Typography
- Brand / system: SF Pro Text (or Inter / Roboto as fallback). Use rounded, geometric sans.
- Title (“Beverages”): 34–36 px, weight 700 (Bold), line-height 40 px, center aligned, color #3A3638.
- Category chip text: 15–16 px, weight 600 for selected, 500 for normal; selected chip text is #FFFFFF, unselected text is #AAACA7.
- Section label (“HYDRATION”): 12 px, weight 700 or 600, letter-spacing 1.5–2 px, color #AAACA7, centered.
- Item title (e.g., “Green Tea”): 17–18 px, weight 700, color #3A3638.
- Item subtitle / metadata (e.g., “25mg caffeine”): 12–13 px, weight 400, color #AAACA7.
- Percentage text: 16–18 px, weight 600, color #3A3638 (aligned right in the row).
- Toggle label / non-text controls: no label; rely on contrast.
UI elements and styles
- Top-left circular back button: circular 44 px diameter, white background, soft shadow, left chevron icon in #3A3638 centered. Touch target 44x44.
- Top-right add control: pill-shaped button (min 56–64 px wide × 36–40 px high), filled with accent #0ABDD7, white “+Add” label and a small drink icon; subtle shadow to lift.
- Category filters (chips): pill-shaped chips, border-radius 20 px, horizontal padding 18 px, vertical padding 10 px, arranged in a centered wrap layout. Spacing between chips: horizontal 12 px, vertical 10 px. Selected chip: fill #3A3638, text #FFFFFF. Unselected chips: fill #F3F4F5, text #AAACA7.
- Section label: small uppercase text in muted gray (#AAACA7), centered with top margin ~28 px above list.
- Card / row container: rounded rectangle with radius 16 px, background #FFFFFF, vertical padding ~16–18 px, horizontal padding 18–20 px, full-width minus safe area margins. Row height ~72–84 px depending on content. Card spacing: vertical gap 12–16 px between cards.
- Row content layout: three logical columns:
  1) Left column (icon + text): Icon container 44×44 px (rounded), left edge padding 6–8 px; beverage icon inside (flat 2–3 color illustration). To the right of icon, stacked texts: title (bold), subtitle smaller muted.
  2) Middle column: percentage text (e.g., “90%”) right aligned in the available space; weight 600 color #3A3638.
  3) Right column: toggle control and small drag-handle icon. Toggle: track 52×30 px, radius 15 px; ON track fill #0ABDD7, OFF track light gray #E9EAEB; knob/handle ~26 px diameter, white with 1px subtle shadow. Toggle has smooth translate animation when switching.
- Iconography: small flat colorful icons matching drink type: water (blue cup), green tea (green cup), coffee (brown cup), milk (muted gray bottle), juice (orange cup), soda (pink can), beer (yellow pint). Icons sized ~28–36 px.
- Drag handle: subtle vertical double-chevron or grip icon placed to the far right, color light gray (#E9EAEB). It indicates reorder/drag affordance.
- Elevated drag preview: when a row is being dragged the card pops above others with stronger shadow: box-shadow: 0 18px 30px rgba(58,54,56,0.12), translateY: -6px, and a faint scale up to 1.02.
- Subtle separators: none heavy; separation is via card spacing and shadow.
Shadows and elevation
- Normal cards: 0 6px 14px rgba(58,54,56,0.04)
- Elevated/dragged card (Milk in screenshot): 0 18px 30px rgba(58,54,56,0.12)
Animations & interaction states
- Toggle transition: 160–220ms, transform/translate for knob with cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) (springy ease-out). Track color crossfade 140ms.
- Card press/drag: scale to 1.02 and elevate shadow; animate over 180–260ms with spring easing.
- Chip pressed/selected: color fill change with 120–160ms ease.
Accessibility & touch targets
- Minimum touch target 44×44 px for chips and buttons. Contrast: primary text on white uses #3A3638 which meets AA for large text. Toggles use color plus position; ensure a label for screen readers.
Specific measurements (recommended)
- Horizontal screen padding (safe area): 18–22 px
- Title top margin from status bar: 18–24 px
- Chip height: 40 px, border-radius 20 px
- Card corner radius: 16 px
- Icon size: 28–36 px
- Toggle track: 52×30 px, knob 26 px
- Inter-card vertical gap: 12–16 px
Assets to recreate
- Flat beverage icons in a small set of bright colors matched to the palette.
- Small drink glyph inside the Add pill.
- Subtle rounded chevron/drag icon for reorder.
Notes
- Keep overall contrast high for primary text and use muted gray for secondary metadata. Use soft shadows to separate cards from the very light page background. Replicate the overlapping elevated card effect when an item is being reordered or long-pressed.
content.layout:
Overall structure
- Safe-area aware top header (single horizontal row) containing three anchored elements: a left circular back control, a centered page title, and a right-aligned pill add control. Header height: ~88 px including status bar/safe area.
- Under header: a wrap layout of category chips (filter chips). Chips are centered horizontally and wrap into multiple rows; there are approximately 3–4 chips per row depending on device width. Chips are grouped visually with even spacing and consistent vertical rhythm.
- Small uppercase section label “HYDRATION” centered above the list, spaced ~18–28 px below the chips.
- Main content: a single column scroll view containing rounded cards/tiles stacked vertically. Each card uses full available width minus horizontal safe-area padding.
Card internal grid / columns
- Each list card can be described as a horizontal 3-column content grid (left/middle/right):
  Column 1 (Left-most, ~50–60% of row width reserved): icon and stacked text. Icon aligned to left of the card, then a vertical stack (title on top, subtitle beneath) aligned left.
  Column 2 (Center-right, ~20%): percentage value, right aligned inside the card.
  Column 3 (Right-most, ~20%): toggle control aligned vertically center and a very small drag handle to the far right edge.
- Visual grouping: the icon + text are grouped together; percentage aligned with toggle to imply that the toggle controls whether that percentage is applied.
Number of columns and groups
- Page-level: single column layout (one main content column).
- Row-level: logically three columns (Icon/Text | Percentage | Toggle+Handle).
Grid/rows
- Vertical list of repeated rows (cards). Approximately 7–8 items visible in the screenshot; spacing between rows is consistent (12–16 px). One card is visually elevated and overlapping the content (Milk) to indicate drag/preview.
Responsive notes
- Chips wrap responsively: on narrow devices they reduce to 2–3 per row, keeping equal horizontal spacing. Card content should remain single column with inner three-column content reflowing: percentage + toggle keep fixed width while the text area shrinks.
Keywords describing layout
- single-column
- center-aligned header
- wrapped chips
- pill filters
- rounded cards
- three-column rows
- left icon stack
- right toggles
- drag handles
- elevated drag preview
content.functions:
Specific actions users can take on this screen
- Tap a category chip to filter the list (chips visually change to selected state). The “All 116” chip displays a count and is selected by default.
- Tap the left circular back control to navigate back.
- Tap the +Add pill to open an input flow or modal to add a new beverage entry.
- Scroll the vertical list to browse beverage items.
- Tap a toggle on the right of a row to enable/disable that beverage (visual feedback: toggle moves, track color changes, row state may change opacity or inclusion in calculations).
- Long-press or press-and-drag a row (drag-handle) to reorder items; the dragged item lifts, casts a stronger shadow and can be moved up or down; when released it settles into new position.
- Tap a row (outside the toggle) to open detail / edit modal for that beverage (name, caffeine mg, hydration % adjustments).
- Read contextual metadata: small caption under item name displays caffeine content or category.
- Visual scanning: central percentage values let users compare hydration effect quickly.
Medium-level workflows
- Filter + toggle workflow: user filters to a category (e.g., Tea) and toggles on/off items to include in their hydration calculation or daily tracking. The UI shows immediate visual confirmation via toggles and updated percentages.
- Reordering & prioritization: user arranges frequently used drinks to top of the list via drag-and-drop so they are easier to access.
- Adding & editing drinks: the +Add opens a short form where a user inputs drink name, icon, hydration %, caffeine mg; upon save the new card appears in the list.
Broader purpose
- The screen’s primary purpose is to act as a catalog/manager of beverages for a hydration or nutrition-tracking product. It enables quick selection and configuration of drinks that contribute to a user’s hydration/caffeine tracking. The filters and toggles speed up selection; percentages present at-a-glance impact values so the user can make immediate decisions. The design supports clarity, fast scanning, and direct manipulation (drag / toggle) for efficient list management.

steps.name: Drop item and update order
steps.goal: Place the beverage in the desired position and finalise the new order
steps.action: Release the dragged card at the target position.
steps.system_response: The list re-renders with the moved beverage inserted in the new position. Visual feedback confirms the change (card returns to standard elevation). Toggles and percentage values remain visible and unchanged. The new order is reflected in the UI (and should be persisted by the app).

content.description:
High-level visual style: Soft, friendly iOS-style mobile interface with generous white space, rounded shapes and subtle shadows. The visual language uses large rounded pills for categories, full-width rounded cards for each beverage row, colorful flat illustrations for each drink, a prominent centered section title, and a bright teal accent for primary actions and toggles.

Color palette (primary + supporting):
- Deep charcoal (headline, selected pill background): #3A3636
- Accent teal (primary action, toggles, icons): #09BCD7
- Warm gold (accent / small highlights): #DCBC05
- Medium neutral (muted text / subtitles): #ABADA8
- Page background / near-white: #FBFBFB
- Card background: very light grey / white: #FFFFFF
- Inactive pill / subtle UI surfaces: #F4F5F6 (approx)
- Toggle knob: #FFFFFF

Typography (recommended font = SF Pro / Inter):
- Page title "Beverages": 34px, 600/700 weight (Semibold/Bold), letter-spacing 0, centered, line-height ~40px, color #3A3636
- Category pill text: 16px, 600 weight for selected, 500/600 for unselected; selected pill text white (#FFFFFF), unselected text #ABADA8; pill height ~40px
- Section label (small caps like HYDRATION): 12px, 600 weight, letter-spacing 1px, color #ABADA8, centered above list
- List item title (e.g., "Green Tea"): 18px, 600 weight, color #3A3636, line-height ~22px
- List item subtitle (e.g., "25mg caffeine"): 13px, 400/500 weight, color #ABADA8, margin-top 4px
- Hydration % value: 16px, 600 weight, color #ABADA8 (slightly lighter than headlines)

Global layout & spacing:
- Safe area top (iPhone status bar) preserved. Top nav area (back button left, +Add pill right) sits in first 56–64px zone.
- Screen uses a single vertical scroll column. Content is center aligned horizontally with side padding ~20–24px.
- Category chips live in a wrapping flow container directly under the title, with vertical spacing of ~18–22px between rows.
- Spacing between card rows ~14–18px. Each card has internal vertical padding ~18–20px and horizontal padding ~18–22px.

Category chips (pills):
- Shape: pill / capsule with full border radius (height/2). Typical size: height 40px, horizontal padding 18px.
- Selected state: background color #3A3636, text white; subtle inner shadow or glow to indicate active. Unselected: background #F4F5F6, text #ABADA8.
- Chips arranged center-aligned and wrap into multiple rows. Some chips include a numeric badge e.g. "All 116" shown as filled capsule.

Top bar & actions:
- Back control: circular button 44x44, soft white background, subtle drop shadow, icon caret left (#3A3636) centered.
- +Add button: rounded capsule ~56x34, filled with teal #09BCD7, white + icon and label "+Add" inside, soft shadow for elevation.

Section header:
- Title "Beverages" centered, large semibold. Small secondary section label "HYDRATION" in uppercase and muted color (#ABADA8) above the list.

List / Rows (Cards & Tiles):
- Each beverage is inside a full-width rounded card with background white (#FFFFFF) and a very subtle drop shadow. Card corner radius ~16–20px.
- Row internal layout: three main horizontal zones (left icon, center content, right actions):
  - Left icon column: fixed width ~44–56px, center vertically. Contains a flat colorful beverage illustration (approx 36x36) with no label inside. Illustrations use saturated colors that visually contrast with the teal accent (examples: green for tea, brown for coffee, yellow for juice, red for soda).
  - Center content column: flexible width, contains title (18px semibold) and optional subtitle (13px regular) stacked vertically, left aligned.
  - Right actions column: percentage value (16px medium) aligned slightly left of the toggle, then the toggle control itself aligned to far right. There is also a vertical drag/reorder affordance (two chevrons) in faint grey to the far right.
- Card height: ~72–84px depending on subtitle presence. Internal vertical padding ~16px.
- Water row shows only title and a 100% value with no toggle (example of conditional controls per item).

Toggle control:
- Capsule slider toggle: track size ~52x30px, filled teal (#09BCD7) when ON, track light grey #E9E9E9 when OFF. Circular knob ~26px, white (#FFFFFF). Interaction: drag or tap.
- Animation: toggle slide transition 180–240ms with cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) easing. On toggle, the track color cross-fades and knob translates horizontally.

Micro-interactions & states:
- Tapping a category chip animates a fast color transition (120–160ms) and updates the list content.
- Tapping +Add opens a modal/drawer to add a beverage.
- Row swipe or long-press may reveal reorder controls (the chevrons at right suggest ordering). Reordering uses lift-and-drag animation with 200–300ms easing.

Icons & imagery:
- Beverage icons are simple flat vector illustrations with 2–3 colors each, no gradients. They are visually distinct and sized to align with headline text baseline.
- Small caret icon for Back is simple stroke 2px, dark color #3A3636.

Accessibility notes:
- Tap targets all >=44x44 px.
- Contrast: ensure dark headline #3A3636 on white meets contrast for body text; percentage text and small caps use #ABADA8 which is lower contrast but readable for secondary information.

Assets to reproduce: vector beverage icons (water cup, teacup with leaf, milk bottle, coffee cup, juice cup with straw, soda can, beer glass), small chevron handle icon for reordering, capsule toggle component, capsule filter chip component, circular back button, teal +Add pill.

Overall layout: a single scrollable vertical column with the following stacked sections from top to bottom: status/top bar, centered page title, multi-row chip filter group (wrapping), a small uppercase section label, then a vertical list of full-width rounded cards (one per beverage). The content is horizontally center-aligned with equal left/right padding.

Detailed row (card) layout (per beverage): three main horizontal columns plus a tiny reorder handle column at far right:

content.description:
Full-screen icon selection interface on an iPhone-style canvas (safe area visible). Overall style: minimal, flat, highly simplified pictogram silhouettes with a single accent color used to indicate selection. Background: very light warm white (#FBFBFB). Primary accent color for selected item and preview: orange (#E27305). Secondary dark control color used for the primary action (Apply): deep desaturated dark (use 0x3C3227 as shown). Neutral placeholder / disabled icon color: pale grey (#E2E3DD). Large preview area: centered near the top, showing a single large filled orange mug illustration with subtle rounded corners on shapes. Below the preview is a multi-row, multi-column grid of smaller icon silhouettes (all single-color fills). Most items are disabled/ghosted with the pale grey; one grid item is active and matches the orange accent and is reflected in the preview. Visual hierarchy is clear: large preview (dominant), icon grid (secondary), action controls (high visual weight due to size and shadow).

Typography: system San Francisco / Inter-style neutral sans (use SF Pro Text for iOS). Status bar numerals use small system weight ~12 pt. Primary button labels use medium/semibold weight ~17–18 pt; color for the dark button label is #FBFBFB (white) and for the light cancel button label is a dark navy/brown (~#3C3227). Line-height for button text ~22 pt. Alignment: centered horizontally for preview and grid, buttons centered as a pair horizontally. 

Iconography and shapes: icons are flat single-fill vector silhouettes with soft rounded corners (corner radius approx 8–12% of icon box), consistent stroke-free shapes. Grid icons are square bounding boxes with internal pictogram centered. The active grid item uses full fill #E27305 and includes a small highlight (straw/cream) at the top; disabled items use uniform pale grey fill with no stroke.

Spacing & sizes (reference for 375pt wide iPhone viewport): safe area left/right margins 16 pt. Large preview icon: approx 140–160 pt square, centered; top margin from status bar ~48–64 pt. Grid: 5 columns, each cell approx 56 pt square with 20 pt horizontal gap and 18–22 pt vertical gap. Grid top margin from preview ~36 pt. Visible rows: about 6–7 rows depending on scrolling. Action controls: two pill buttons placed in a horizontal row, centered above bottom safe area; each pill approx 150 pt width × 64 pt height, corner radius 32 pt for a capsule shape. Gap between pills ~16 pt. Cancel button: white background (#FBFBFB) with subtle inset shadow and dark label; Apply button: dark filled capsule using 0x3C3227 with white text. Both buttons sit on a soft elevated shadow: drop shadow rgba(60,50,39,0.12) or similar, blur 24–30 px, y-offset 8–12 px to create a floating look.

Borders, shadows, and states: disabled icons use no border and reduced opacity (approx 40–50%); active icon and preview use full opacity and full accent color. Buttons have distinct states: default (as described), pressed state should slightly reduce elevation and scale (0.98), and show a subtle color darken for the Apply pill. Hover states (if desktop) should slightly raise shadow and increase contrast. 

Micro-interactions & animation: tapping a grid icon animates a quick 120–180 ms ease-out transition: the tapped icon scales up slightly (1.15x) then transitions into the large preview via a crossfade/scale animation (scaled fade lasting 300 ms, easing: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)). When switching selection, the previously selected grid icon crossfades to grey while the new icon fills orange; preview updates with a brief pop (scale 1 → 1.06 → 1 with 200 ms). The Apply and Cancel buttons animate in from the bottom on screen entrance with 320 ms slide+fade easing. Disabled icons remain non-interactive and show pointer/gesture disabled state.

Accessibility & touch targets: grid icons have tappable hit targets of at least 44×44 pt; pills are 44+ pt tall and easy to tap. Contrast: primary dark Apply pill to white text passes contrast; pale grey icons are intentionally low-contrast as disabled elements. Provide accessible labels for each icon and VoiceOver support announcing selection and Apply/Cancel actions.

Columns & grouping: The grid uses 5 equal columns across the available content width (safe area width = viewport width minus 32 pt total horizontal margin). Each grid cell contains a single icon centered in its cell. The grid is a single group (one grid) with multiple row groups for visual organization; there is no left/right sidebar. The two action buttons are grouped as a single control cluster — centered and overlapping the lower portion of the grid (visually layered above with shadow). 

Grid details: Columns: 5. Rows: variable (6–8 visible + scroll). Cell size: ~56 pt square. Horizontal gap: ~20 pt; vertical gap: ~18–22 pt. Preview row: independent element positioned above the grid with significant breathing room (top margin ~36–56 pt). Buttons: a two-column cluster horizontally (two pills) centered as a single row, each pill one logical column in that cluster.
content.functions:

Broader goal: The interface is a dedicated icon-picker modal whose overall purpose is to let users pick and confirm a pictogram to represent a category, product, or profile item. - From the user's perspective: They want to find the incorrect drink in the day's list, delete it quickly and safely (with a confirmation), and then confirm the day's totals reflect the removal (hydation oz, percent of goal, and consumed total). At the very top-left there is a rounded capsule showing a small circular step/position number and a brown label with the current challenge or streak name; a slim teal arc on the capsule indicates micro-progress. Top-right shows a small round icon (three wavy lines) used as a secondary menu or filter.

Color palette (approximate hex values used on screen)
- Primary bright teal (metric and accents): #12C0B9
- Deep header brown (capsule): #6D3F33 (brown coffee tone visible in capsule and lower card accent)
- Brown tail segment: #6D3F33 (same brown used at the bottom of the tail)
- Cyan/blue tail segment: #12C0B9 (matches primary accent)

- Top-left micro progress arc: #12C0B9
(Developer-provided accent colors also present in palette: #414471, #D3B90F, #A0445F, #4950D3 — use these as additional accents where appropriate)

Typography
- Platform: iOS-native look (suggest SF Pro Text / SF Pro Display). Use system weight tokens for crisp rendering.
- Time in status bar: San Francisco Regular ~13–14 px (left aligned in top status area). Color: near-black #111111.
- Capsule label (Escape Caffeine Capuchin): SF Pro Display SemiBold ~16–18 px, white text on brown capsule. Vertical padding ~8–10 px, horizontal padding ~18–24 px. Label is centered vertically in capsule; left of capsule is a small circular number badge.
- Primary metric (20.3oz): Large headline size, approx 56–72 px (40–56 pt on iOS), heavy weight (SF Pro Display Bold). Color: #12C0B9. Letter-spacing neutral (0–0.5 px). Centered horizontally.
- Sub-label (Hydration • 22% of your goal): SF Pro Text Regular ~16 px, color #9EA6AE. A small water-drop icon (filled with #DFF6FA and inner tear #12C0B9) aligns to the right of this line.
- Bottom labels under drink icons: uppercase small-caps look (SF Pro Text Bold or Letterspaced), ~11–12 px, color #C7C7C7.

Elements and components (visual specs)
1) Status & top controls
   - Status bar: device time at top-left, standard iOS status icons on top-right.
   - Capsule (top-left): Rounded rectangle with large corner radius (~24–28 px height ~42 px). Leftmost is a small circle (34 px diameter) with the number “1” (white on brown) overlapped by capsule; a small teal progress arc (semi-circle, 22–26 px radius, stroke ~4 px) wraps ~20% around the top-left of the number circle to indicate micro progress. Capsule casts a subtle drop shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.06), blur ~8 px, offset y 2 px).
   - Top-right circular menu: 44 px diameter white circle with subtle drop shadow and a dark-blue wavy-lines icon centered.

2) Primary metric block
   - Large numeric text: 20.3oz in teal #12C0B9, centered horizontally. Use generous top margin from capsule (~36–48 px).
   - Sub-label: single-line gray text (#9EA6AE) below numeric; small teal droplet icon flush to the right (icon diameter ~20 px) inside a pale aqua circle (#DFF6FA) with subtle border.

3) Central illustration & progress tail
   - Illustration: Very large, faint monkey silhouette centered and vertically filling roughly the middle half of the screen. Color is very light gray (#F2F3F4) so it reads like background art. The silhouette's tail extends downward toward the lower-center of the screen.
   - Progress tail: At the tail’s lower curve is a horizontally segmented ribbon of color bands (three or four stacked stripes) that fill left-to-right around the curl. Each band is a flat color: green, cyan, brown (values given above). The filled segments have a slight rounded cap and tiny 1–2 px hairline where segments meet (imitate paint strokes). The tail sits visually on top of the monkey silhouette (higher z-index) and is the primary progress indicator.
   - The tail and monkey have minimal shadowing; the tail can have a small inner-shadow to suggest depth (inner stroke darker by 6–8%).

4) Bottom quick-add row
   - Horizontal row of 5 clickable drink icons centered near the bottom: from left to right: SODA, BEER, RED WINE, STRONG LIQUOR, ADD OR EDIT. Each icon is a stylized flat illustration (bottle/glass) with color fill and small white highlight/shimmy. Each icon sits above a small circular pinkish/beige plus badge (14–18 px diameter) used to add that drink. Under each icon is a small uppercase label (SODA, BEER, RED WINE, STRONG LIQUOR, ADD OR EDIT) in muted gray (~#C7C7C7) with tracking/letter spacing of ~1.5 px. Icon size about 52–64 px tall, horizontal spacing between icons about 28–34 px.
   - The ADD OR EDIT entry is a circular pale aqua button (about 56 px diameter) with an inner teal plus symbol (#12C0B9) centered. This control uses a softer radial shadow and sits slightly raised above the icon baseline.

5) Lower floating card
   - A rounded, partially visible beige card is anchored to the bottom of the screen (corner radius ~20–26 px). Inside it is a coffee-bean icon and the challenge label "Escape Caffeine Capuchin ✓ 9d" in brown text (#6D3F33). This card has large internal padding (20–24 px) and a soft shadow.

Microcopy & icons
- All iconography is rounded, friendly and slightly illustrative, using flat fills with occasional white highlights. The plus badges attached to icons are circular and use a soft pink background with white plus sign.

Interaction states
- Buttons (drink icons / add) have touch states: on-press scale down to 0.96 with a short 100ms cycle and change to a 10–12% darker shade. Disabled state: 40% opacity.
- Capsule micro-progress arc animates when user adds drink.

Animations & transitions
- Tail-fill animation: when the user adds volume, the tail’s colored bands animate in from left to right along the tail path. Duration ~450ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) (easeOutBack feel with slight overshoot). Each segment appears in sequence with a stagger of 60–80ms for a layered fill effect.
- Numeric increment: the primary metric animates its value incrementally (count-up) over ~300–500ms, with a subtle vertical scale bounce (scaleY to 1.06 then back to 1.0) to draw attention.
- Badge micro-feedback: plus badge pulses (scale 1.1 → 1.0) on add for 180ms.

Spacing & layout grid (for replication)
- Safe area: top and bottom safe area respected (iPhone notch). Content is centered in a single column grid with a 24–28 px horizontal gutter.
- Vertical rhythm: capsule top offset from top safe area ~18–22 px; metric block margin-top ~18 px from capsule; sub-label margin ~8–12 px below metric; big monkey illustration top aligned to begin about 12 px below sub-label and extends to about 60% of screen height; bottom quick-add row baseline is ~56–84 px above bottom safe area; lower card is anchored to bottom with 16–20 px side margins.

Assets and icons to provide to developer

Accessibility
- Provide readable contrast for numeric (teal on white yields good contrast). Use larger tap targets (44 x 44 px minimum) for drink icons and floating add button.

Notes for replication
- Use SF Pro Display/Text for the iOS look and letter-spacing to match small uppercase labels. Keep the monkey art intentionally low-contrast so the metric and tail stand out as primary focus. Use vector shapes for the tail to allow smooth stroke/fill animation.

records.description: Happy path: a signed-in user configures a home-screen widget called “Widgets”. Entry point is the widget configuration screen (header: Widgets) where the user can: choose widget size (Medium or Small), preview the widget, pick a palette color (or add custom color), and edit each beverage slot (Beverage 1..3). Selecting a beverage opens a beverage list where the user chooses a drink and its default size is shown. Exiting returns the user to the previous screen. Assumptions: user is already in the app and on the widget-config area; changes are reflected immediately in the preview; beverage options and sizes are pre-populated.
records.problem: User goal: customize a Medium widget's appearance and its beverage slots so the widget reflects the user's preferred color and drinks. From the user's perspective they expect to: 1) see a live preview of the widget, 2) change the widget background color from a palette or custom color, 3) open a beverage slot, pick a beverage (and implicitly use the shown default size), and 4) see those changes reflected in the preview and the slot summary list. From the interface perspective: the UI exposes a size toggle, a preview card, a palette grid with a selected indicator, a custom color area, and a horizontal list of beverage slot rows. Tapping a beverage row navigates to a beverage-selection list that shows each drink with an icon and a size chip. Selecting a drink marks it with a check and returns to the configuration screen. Result: user-perceived outcome is the widget preview and the beverage slot summary update immediately to show the chosen color and drinks; system-level outcome (visible in UI) is the selection state for color and beverage rows, updated preview visuals, and updated summary text for each Beverage row.

Chip diameter ~44px; grid gap/horizontal spacing ~18px; vertical spacing ~18px. Selected chip has a dark ring (stroke ~4px in #383538) and an inner tick/check icon.
- Custom area: below the grid is a horizontal divider, the label "CUSTOM" (centered, muted gray). Below that are two large circles: an existing custom color (blue) and a plus-circle for creating a new custom color. Plus circle background ~#EFEFF1, plus icon medium gray.

- Each beverage row has a small, colorful custom flat illustration (not a photo) that visually references the drink (cup, bottle, glass, can, wine glass). Illustrations use simple shapes and 2–3 colors and are vertically centered in the card.

Each swatch is a perfect circle (approx. 48 px diameter) with consistent spacing (gutters ~18–22 px). The currently selected swatch has a dark circular stroke ring around it (thick border ~6 px, color very dark #2E3340) and a small checkmark icon centered (dark check on pale mint fill inside the ring). Directly under the grid is a subtle divider line, and a centered label “CUSTOM” in small uppercase gray text (approx. 12–13 px, weight medium, color #BFC7C3).

Under the CUSTOM label are two larger circular slots: one filled (bright blue circle used as a custom saved color) and one with a light gray circular button containing a plus icon to add a new custom color. These custom circles are approx. 56–66 px diameter and spaced horizontally.

Below the color card the screen continues with a vertical list of three rounded list rows (full width inside margins) representing beverage entries. Each row is a rounded rectangular tile with a faint shadow and very light gray fill (#F6F7F7).
